ValidationRule.description: Prohibits a Credit Review from being changed to Status EP Review Done if Annual Revenue is null. Only applies to outsource processors. Added Exception for Renewal 4/4/21 - to support Ocrolus processing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISBLANK(Annual_Revenue__c) && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'EP Review Done') && $Profile.Name = 'NF - Outsource Processor - WC' && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.Type,'RENEWAL'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Annual Revenue must be entered before you can Complete Processing. You may need to refresh the page to enable the Complete Processing button.
